title: Stop pinning verification state into spec prose — § Next Steps item 1 self-falsifies on every phase-level write
description: Route through /iterate (DEC-016 — every edit is spec body text). § Next Steps & Priorities item 1 (spec_v1.md ~line 1616) states: '.claude/verification-result.json holds that phase-level result against spec_fingerprint 3909f351' and '13/13 criteria (2026-08-05)'. Two problems. (1) SELF-FALSIFYING: the moment the orchestrator writes the 2026-08-07 re-verification result, verification-result.json holds a475793a, not 3909f351, and the sentence becomes false — a false status assertion baked into a pinned section fingerprint, i.e. exactly the FR-052 class task-057 was created to eliminate, reintroduced by task-057's own correction text. (2) AUTHORITY DUPLICATION: DEC-022 assigns phase-acceptance status authority to verification-result.json's criteria[] and explicitly not to spec body text; restating the file's contents in prose creates a second, always-decaying copy of a field the spec is not the authority for. FIX SHAPE (generalize, do not just refresh the numbers — refreshing them recreates the defect on the next re-verification): replace the pinned fingerprint, criteria count and date with a pointer — e.g. 'Phase-level verification has run and passed; .claude/verification-result.json is the authority for its result, fingerprint and date (DEC-022)' — plus, if a narrative anchor is wanted, the durable non-decaying facts only (that the first phase-level run was 2026-08-05, that it produced fix tasks 057-061, and that all five were accuracy-of-the-record rather than correctness-of-the-build). While in the section, apply the same treatment to any sibling hardcoded derived count that no 'as of <date>' disclaimer protects. Do NOT touch § Testing Strategy's '282 tests as of 2026-08-06' — that one carries its own disclaimer and is currently accurate (re-measured 282 passed, 2026-08-07).
acceptanceCriteria: § Next Steps & Priorities item 1 no longer names a specific spec_fingerprint value, and no longer restates the criteria count or verification date as spec-owned fact.
The section points a reader at .claude/verification-result.json as the status authority, citing DEC-022.
Re-running phase-level verification (which rewrites verification-result.json) would leave the section's remaining claims true — verified by reading the new text against a hypothetical next result.
No other section of spec_v1.md pins a fingerprint value or an undisclaimed derived count.
notes:
[ATTEMPT 2] Attempt 1 FAILED AC4 and the failure was real: the AC4 sweep keyed on a noun list (tasks|tests|measures|checks|tables) that omitted 'entries', so BLOCKING_CHECKS 'currently **13 entries**' (L1122) was silently missed — the same lexical-sweep failure mode task-057 already documented. The attempt-1 note then ASSERTED the sweep was clean, which was itself an instance of the defect this task removes. Both are corrected here.

Attempt 1 changes (retained, all verified passing AC1-AC3): § Next Steps & Priorities item 1 no longer pins spec_fingerprint/criteria-count/date and points at verification-result.json; the '**All spec tasks are closed** ... 74 Finished' opening was false on both halves and became a non-decaying Phase 1-4 statement; item 2's FR-052/FR-053/FR-060 enumeration was already stale and became a pointer to friction.jsonl.

Attempt 2 changes (AC4 + FR-064): L1122 'currently **13 entries**' -> '*(13 entries as of 2026-08-10)*'; L1114 '**14** check functions' gains the same parenthetical date; § Testing Strategy gains one governing disclaimer at 'Testing Approach:' covering L1317/L1323 rather than four near-duplicate parentheticals; the DEC-022 citation is disambiguated as template-tier with an inline path, because every other DEC-NNN in the spec resolves to .claude/support/decisions/decision-0NN and that directory holds only 001-013 (FR-064). L1325 ('two CREATE TABLE scripts, zero INSERTs') deliberately left alone — a structural fact about files on disk, not a drifting measurement; confirmed directly by the phase-level run.

All fixes follow the spec's own established disclaimer form (L1026, L307, L1307). Spec fingerprint a475793a -> da20c9be -> 836adbd4; spec_v1.index.json regenerated after each. NOT re-swept by regex: the second structural sweep attempt produced 15 candidates of which most were headings/ranges/bounds, so the authoritative AC4 evidence is a section-by-section read, not a pattern match.

issues.description: AC4 unmet: spec_v1.md L1122 (§ Pipeline Blocking Gate) states BLOCKING_CHECKS is 'currently 13 entries' — an undisclaimed derived count with no governing 'as of <date>' in § Data Quality & Validation (L1042-1155), exactly the self-falsifying class the task exists to eliminate.
Same class, weaker: L1114 '14 check functions', L1317 'collects 45 tests', L1323 '7 tests', L1325 'two CREATE TABLE scripts, zero INSERTs' carry no own as-of date.

The completion note claimed 'every remaining derived count carries an as of <date> disclaimer' — false for L1122 and the L1114/L1317/L1323/L1325 group, so AC4 was asserted rather than swept; correct the note alongside the fix.

verification_history.notes: AC1/AC2/AC3 pass; AC4 fails on a literal whole-spec sweep (BLOCKING_CHECKS '13 entries', L1122).

issues.description: L1325/L1134 '/azure/ holds DDL only — two CREATE TABLE scripts, zero INSERTs' has no as-of date; accepted as a structural fact about an inert input directory (verified currently true), recorded so the carve-out is explicit rather than implicit.

L1317's '(9 -> 12 -> 14)' is a DQ-check count under a disclaimer scoped to 'the suite', so it is covered by its cross-reference to § Data Quality & Validation rather than by the governing clause itself.
§ Phase Structure table (L1590-1593) still stops at Phase 4 while L1610 now asserts Phase 5 exists — an incompleteness, outside this task's scope.

verification_history.notes: PASS attempt 2. AC1/AC2/AC3 re-verified against the CURRENT spec (not carried over from attempt 1). AC3 was demonstrated live rather than hypothetically: verification-result.json still holds a475793a/2026-08-07/13-13 while the spec is 836adbd4, so the OLD text would already be doubly false and every claim in the NEW text survives. AC4 PASS by an enumerate-and-classify sweep, method stated for audit: 974 numeric tokens extracted with no lexical filter, provably-exempt classes mechanically masked (ISO dates, GUIDs, hex-8, task/FR/DEC/FB ids, versions, years, section refs) leaving 432, each residual read and classified per-site; 18 derived-count sites found, all 18 carrying a governing or inline as-of disclaimer; zero fingerprint pins remain. The governing-disclaimer scope was checked rather than assumed: L1309 sits on the Testing Approach line and scopes over L1317/L1323 by list-membership and section, and L1307 carries exactly one date so the reference resolves unambiguously. The new 'as of 2026-08-10' dates were re-measured rather than trusted: 14 check functions (3 ways), BLOCKING_CHECKS parses to exactly 13 tuples, pytest --collect-only gives 282/45/7 — all match, so no fix introduced a false date. The L1325 carve-out was independently judged sound, with the reasoning recorded.
